title: ebi-metagenomics/mobilome-annotation-pipeline pipeline - params.annotation_manifest schema
description: Schema for the annotation manifest provided with --annotation_manifest. Each row maps a sample to pre-computed annotation files from the genomes-catalogue-pipeline. All annotation columns are optional.

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces. Must match the sample column in the input samplesheet.

ips_tsv.errorMessage: InterProScan TSV annotation file (optionally compressed with .gz). Routed to PATHOFACT2 and COMBINEREPORTER only.

amrfinder_tsv.errorMessage: AMRFinderPlus raw TSV output from the genomes-catalogue-pipeline (optionally compressed with .gz). Column layout differs from the MAP-internal run and is normalised automatically.

antismash_gff.errorMessage: antiSMASH GFF output from the genomes-catalogue-pipeline (optionally compressed with .gz).

gecco_gff.errorMessage: GECCO GFF output from the genomes-catalogue-pipeline (optionally compressed with .gz).

sanntis_gff.errorMessage: SanntiS GFF output from the genomes-catalogue-pipeline (optionally compressed with .gz).
